value:
3 minigames to complete, each with their own defeat scenes. 4 lives before a gameover scene. 
Stage1 - Explore a grid to find 3 keys before you can leave, each key spawns a succubus hunter which loses you a life when colliding with the player. 
Stage2 - Bounce up a wall of floating platforms, press left- and right-click to change the direction of movement. Falling into the void loses you a life. 
Stage3 - Flappy bird-like game where you avoid the floating angels. Colliding with an angel loses you a life.
